newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 20.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 20.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Zoltan Gal, the speaker of Hungary's parliament said it would not be in Russia's interest to worsen economic relations with Hungary because of the country's NATO expnasion plans.
- The government is discussing amendments of the penal code that would result in more appropriate sanctions to different crimes.
- Eductaion will have a determining role in a balanced labour market, say the authors of a study published on Thursday.
- The parliament's budget committee will debate today the amendments to the farming strategy proposed by Pest county farmers.
- AN European Union official said Hungary is making good progress in adapting its legal system to that of the EU.
